**22 domains · 230 capabilities · 26 journeys · 67 REST operations · 67 MCP tools.**

Follow a branch to find its behavior, access boundary and engineering guide. Use the site search to find a specific capability.

This is an implementation inventory, not a live availability dashboard. Current account capabilities, authority, provider activation and release evidence determine what can run. See [evidence boundaries](/engineering/testing/).
